import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';

test('guided library discovery shares exact source provenance across learner and protected Review',()=>{
 const sha=(b:Uint8Array)=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
 const base='public/atlas-runtime/head-neck/';
 const learner=JSON.parse(readFileSync(base+'manifest.json','utf8'));
 const review=JSON.parse(readFileSync('atlas-review/manifest.json','utf8'));
 assert.equal(learner.sourceCommit,'9fba9a1e24b6669aafd48e945d55fc0939d50ab2');
 assert.equal(review.revision,learner.sourceCommit);
 const inputs=JSON.parse(readFileSync(base+'source-inputs.json','utf8'));
 const rendererPath='content/body-renderer-revision.json';
 const rendererBytes=readFileSync('atlas-review/'+rendererPath);
 const rendererFile=review.files.find((f:{path:string})=>f.path===rendererPath);
 assert(rendererFile);
 assert.equal(rendererFile.sourceSha256,'5fb911cd62e63452591d7dff7fe474c0dccf80485290c1c7afd60ff0ac08ae33');
 assert.equal(sha(rendererBytes),rendererFile.importedSha256);
 const renderer=JSON.parse(rendererBytes.toString());
 for(const path of ['app/whole-body-guided-learning.tsx','app/whole-body-guided-learning.css']){
  const source=inputs.find((f:{path:string})=>f.path===path);
  const imported=review.files.find((f:{path:string})=>f.path===path);
  assert(source&&imported,path);
  assert.equal(renderer.dependencies.find((f:{path:string})=>f.path===path)?.sha256,source.sha256);
  assert.equal(imported.sourceSha256,source.sha256);
  const bytes=readFileSync('atlas-review/'+path);
  assert.equal(sha(bytes),imported.importedSha256);
  const original=path.endsWith('.tsx')?bytes.toString().replaceAll('@/atlas-review/','@/'):bytes.toString();
  assert.equal(sha(Buffer.from(original)),source.sha256,'Only the established Review import namespace may differ');
 }
 const runtime=learner.files.filter((f:{path:string})=>/\.(js|css)$/.test(f.path)).map((f:{path:string;sha256:string})=>{
  const bytes=readFileSync(base+f.path);assert.equal(sha(bytes),f.sha256);return bytes.toString();
 }).join('\n');
 for(const label of ['Find a tour','Search tours','No tours match. Clear filters to see all tours.','whole-body-tour-discovery','whole-body-tour-choice','outside filters'])assert(runtime.includes(label),label);
 const chooser=readFileSync('atlas-review/app/whole-body-guided-learning.tsx','utf8');
 assert.match(chooser,/value=\{tour\.id\}/,'Native chooser reflects the active tour');
 assert.match(chooser,/!currentVisible&&<option value=\{tour\.id\} disabled/,'Hidden active tour remains identifiable, not a selectable result');
 assert(!chooser.includes('whole-body-current-tour'),'No duplicate current-title row');
 for(const prop of ['patientDataIncluded','clinicalApproved','standaloneReviewConnection','imagingConnection'])assert.equal(learner[prop],false);
});
